commands.name: add_jira_comment
commands.description: Adds a comment to a specific Jira ticket.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: The ID or key of the Jira ticket (e.g., 'PROJ-123').

params.name: comment_body
params.description: The text content of the comment to add.

commands.name: transition_jira_ticket
commands.description: Changes the status of a Jira ticket (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done').

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: The ID or key of the Jira ticket (e.g., 'PROJ-123').

params.name: transition_id
params.description: The ID of the transition to execute. You can get this from the Jira API.

commands.name: update_jira_ticket_fields
commands.description: Updates one or more fields of a Jira ticket.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: The ID or key of the Jira ticket (e.g., 'PROJ-123').

params.name: fields
params.description: A JSON object containing the fields to update
